Name: main
Doc: agentmux-kernel dispatches one fixed protected role per supervised process.

Name: main
Doc: agentmux-runtime starts or queries the explicitly enrolled local host.

Name: deployment
Doc: Package deployment configures infrastructure outside the protected assembly.

Name: assembly
Doc: Package assembly verifies a fixed protected release before a supervisor launches it.

Name: boot
Doc: Package boot observes the required protected peers before declaring kernel boot ready.

Name: communication
Doc: Package communication builds the initial protected broker boundary.

Name: lifecycle
Doc: Package lifecycle publishes protected peer observations; direct process controls remain with the supervisor.

Name: protocol
Doc: Package protocol contains shared wire parsing and local transport helpers, not a plugin bus.

Name: status
Doc: Package status publishes bounded kernel information, not application L04 status.

Name: runtime
Doc: Package runtime owns only the protected processes it starts itself.
